title: should render PromQL time-slice form with correct field visibility
verifies: Selecting Time-Slice SLI + Metrics stream + PromQL hides scope field, shows absent note, defaults comparator, and pre-selects PromQL language

title: should save a PromQL Time-Slice SLO with correct payload shape
verifies: Saving a PromQL time-slice SLO emits POST with query_language=prom_ql, comparator=<, stream_type=metrics, no scope key, no count-source keys

title: should flip language between SQL and PromQL, clearing expression and toggling scope
verifies: Toggling between SQL and PromQL on time-slice branch clears the aggregate expression and bidirectionally toggles scope field visibility

title: should swap count fields from SQL to PromQL and show range hint
verifies: Selecting Count SLI + Metrics + PromQL swaps scope/good-expr fields for good/total, shows range hint, and hides SQL fields

title: should load stored SLO without regeneration warning and preserve comparator
verifies: Editing a stored PromQL SLO does not show regeneration warning on load or after name-only change; stored comparator and PromQL language survive

title: should hide language toggle when stream type is not metrics
verifies: Language toggle is hidden on both count and time-slice branches when stream type is logs (non-metrics)

title: should show empty preview state when no aggregate expression is entered
verifies: Time-slice preview section renders the empty/needs-definition state when aggregate expression is blank

title: should preserve branch state when switching between SLI types and languages
verifies: Switching between time-slice and count branches preserves per-branch stream/language state; saved payload has no cross-branch key leakage
